name: vCred
oneLiner: vCRED is a Hemi-based credit-token dollar backed by protocol-managed crypto and credit collateral, with admin-controlled mint authority on a young chain.
collateral: Hemi-based credit and crypto collateral backing vCRED
pegMechanism: Credit-token stable asset with protocol-managed collateral and redemption/liquidity controls on Hemi

oracleRisk.summary: vCRED is a staking and access token for a market-making and perpetual-vault platform; public product docs do not describe borrower-owned collateral positions or a token-level liquidation oracle.

branchApplicability.rationale: vCred describes an AI liquidity layer with vaults, single-side staking, and market-making strategies for perpetual venues. The reviewed product page does not describe borrower CDPs, collateralized debt positions, or oracle-triggered liquidation branches for vCRED itself.

blacklistabilityReview.evidence: Re-reviewed 2026-07-30. Sole catalogued deployment is Hemi 0x7188…0aa1. Verified source (explorer API) is OpenZeppelin ERC20 + ERC20Burnable + Ownable and states free transferability; onlyOwner mint(address,uint256) is the sole privileged path; burn paths are the stock holder/allowance burns (burn(uint256) present; no burn(address,uint256) onlyOwner seize). At Hemi block 4965111: non-proxy (EIP-1967 implementation/admin slots zero); owner()=Safe 0x3ede…75Be; bytecode lacks pause/paused/isBlacklisted/blacklist/freeze/setOperator selectors. No upstream stablecoin wrapper inheritance. Freeze reach is none; transfer posture is permissionless. Transfer categorical publication still requires chainCirculatingById for material deployment scope.

mintAuthority.summary: vCRED mint() is onlyOwner; the onchain owner is a Gnosis Safe v1.4.1+L2 (1-of-2 multisig) with no modules and no guard.

controls.label: vCRED token owner (Gnosis Safe 1-of-2)
controls.evidence: At Hemi block 4610504, owner() on 0x71881974e96152643c74a8e0214b877cfb2a0aa1 returned 0x3eDEEF3ae2e9aA5B55e5Ce4D324f9C24165C75Be. eth_getCode at that address returned non-empty bytecode confirming a contract (not an EOA). Safe API (hemi slug) returned threshold=1, owners=[0x29Aa2eD..., 0x8b01d375...], modules=[], guard=0x0, version=1.4.1+L2. getModules() RPC call returned empty array; guard slot=0x0 confirmed no guard.

review.evidence: At Hemi block 4610504: owner() = 0x3eDEEF (contract, not EOA); Safe API confirmed 1-of-2 Safe v1.4.1+L2, no modules, no guard. Corrected authorityType from eoa to safe with full Safe snapshot. No credible recurring reconciliation was established. The reviewed official vCRED site presents a forthcoming product but does not publish a dated independent reserve, collateral, or supply-to-assets reconciliation, its cadence, or an attestation provider. It also supplies no exact registry-backed prudential supervisor for the issuer or product. Reviewed 2026-07-15.

reserveReview.reviewer: Kimi P2 reserve cohort rc-4 (lead usdf-falcon)
reserveReview.rationale: vCRED's public materials describe programmable vaults on Hemi with single-sided staking and protocol-managed strategies, but publish no verifiable reserve composition, attestation, or per-position breakdown. The envelope is therefore one aggregate classified basket with an explicit insufficient-evidence disposition rather than invented weights.
reserveReview.compositionBasis: vCRED public site; no verifiable reserve composition or attestation is published
reserveReview.knownUnknownExposure: The credit-versus-crypto split, constituent assets, obligors, and weights inside the vCRED vaults are undisclosed.

nonLinkDispositions.rationale: No primary source publishes the vault composition, so the basket cannot be split or linked to tracked assets.

custodyProfile.reviewer: Kimi P2 reserve cohort rc-4 (lead usdf-falcon)
custodyProfile.uncertainty: vCRED describes smart-contract vaults with automated agents on Hemi; the reviewed sources do not establish who controls the vaults, any legal segregation or insolvency treatment, or whether deposited assets are redeployed beyond the described strategies.

mechanismArchetypeReview.rationale: Hemi transaction 0x8fb15ea8eb517f7503e73ddf4c3e7d28facb54d8cbac30ee64c3566314030be2 created the exact tracked vCRED contract at block 1,813,663 on May 19, 2025. vCRED presents the token as a managed credit and crypto-collateral vault asset, supporting the rwa-credit-fund archetype.
